title: The Fault Finding on a Settled Loss and What Further Cost Is Accepted At
content:
Who the most recent appraisal standing on a Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment found responsible for the loss, and whether the marketplace has recovered anything since, settles how much of the further cost is accepted.

- Where the most recent appraisal standing on the enrolment found the guest at fault and a recovery stands on the enrolment in the six months before, the further cost is accepted in full.
- Where that appraisal found the guest at fault and no recovery stands in that period, it is accepted at the marketplace's pending-recovery share of 95 percent.
- Where that appraisal found anyone other than the guest responsible, it is accepted at the marketplace's no-fault share of 85 percent.

### The readings set out

| Finding on the most recent appraisal standing | Recovery in the six months before | Accepted at |
|---|---|---|
| the guest at fault | one or more | the whole of it |
| the guest at fault | none | 95 percent |
| the host at fault, someone outside the trip, nobody at fault, or not settled | either | 85 percent |

A finding that responsibility has not been settled is a finding of someone other than the guest for this purpose, and the lowest share governs. Where several appraisals stand on the enrolment, only the most recent of them is read.

### The record the reading is taken from

The finding is the one carried on the most recent appraisal standing on this enrolment, and the recoveries counted are those received on the enrolment within the six months before.
